pseudos.pseudo: A strategic reinvention, framed as an acceleration toward an AI-driven future, masks a classic capital-labor rebalancing. The imperative to co-locate teams in select hubs is an act of spatial consolidation, where the physical footprint of labor is contracted to better serve the abstract demands of capital. The workforce becomes a variable to be optimized, its dispersal or consolidation dictated by the latest logic of technological accumulation.

The apparatus of strategic realignment is set in motion by executive fiat. A directive from the apex of the corporate hierarchy initiates the elimination of three thousand roles, a number that renders individual tenure a mere administrative detail. The offer of severance—a calculated buyout of time—accompanies the winding down of peripheral offices, the physical dissolution of local labor nodes.

The result is a material redistribution of resources and security. Approximately three thousand full-time positions are excised, a direct transfer of risk from the corporate entity to the individual worker. Concurrently, two geographic offices enter dissolution, severing the link between community and corporate presence. The final ledger shows a leaner structure for capital and a dispersed, precarious cohort for labor.

A great house, seeking to reinvent itself after long contemplation, chose to gather its scattered sons and daughters into a few hallowed centers. There, they would kindle new flames, chasing the lightning of artificial thought. To make room for this vision, many hearths were quenched. The chief, a modern king, decreed the shedding of three thousand souls, offering each a portion of their former wages—a cold mercy. Thus did the old cities of Reno and Woodland Hills fall silent, their purpose fulfilled, their walls left to echo with the footsteps of those who departed, destined to wander until the wheel turns anew.

Fate demanded a sacrifice upon the altar of progress. The decree was simple: to bring the scattered tribes together, to fan the embers of a new, intelligent fire. Three thousand were chosen to bear the cost, their labor severed with the precision of a blade. A payment was promised, a final token measured in weeks and years of service, but it could not mend the thread of purpose now cut. And so, two cities, once bustling with the craft of numbers and forms, were abandoned to the quiet, their halls winding down into memory.

The cycle turned, as it always does. A titan of commerce, after months of silent review, concluded that its current form was no longer enough. To chase the new god of algorithms, it must first become leaner, more focused. This was the foreordained pruning: roles were to be severed, a costly severance of sixteen weeks of base pay offered as a balm for the inevitable. Offices in two realms were to be laid to rest, their functions absorbed into greater hubs. It was not an end, but a metamorphosis, written long ago in the stars of ambition.

It all began with a poorly formatted spreadsheet on a Thursday afternoon. The tab labeled 'Q3 AI Projections' had a single cell with a stray space, causing the formula to return #VALUE! instead of a number. This corrupted a master cost-benefit analysis, which, when presented to the CEO's advisory committee, made the AI-driven future look unexpectedly expensive. That one erroneous cell, buried in row 1,284, is why 3,000 jobs were eventually cut and two offices closed.

pseudos.pseudo: No one remembers the misheard order in the elevator. A junior analyst, holding a coffee and a phone, mumbled 'accelerate the AI stuff' into the closing doors. The executive inside, distracted by a notification, heard 'eliminate the AI staff.' This whispered misunderstanding fed a rumor that grew into a formal review, culminating in a plan to co-locate teams and cut 3,000 roles, offering 16 weeks of pay to ease the blow.

The untightened screw was a calendar invite. A meeting to discuss 'strategic hubs' was accidentally sent with a 15-minute delay to the Reno office head. By the time they joined, the decision to wind down their office was already sketched on a whiteboard. This small scheduling error, a one-second oversight in a shared calendar, locked in the fate of the building and hundreds of roles.

candidates.title: Beyond Darkness
candidates.overview: A priest and his family move into a new house, without knowing that it was built over the place where twenty witches were burnt at the stake.

candidates.title: Home Made Home
candidates.overview: Goofy's building a house, and struggling with the blueprints, the window glass, the paint, and finally the house-warming guests.

candidates.title: The Hexer
candidates.overview: A heroic fantasy based on the famous novels by Polish writer Andrzej Sapkowski, "The Sword of Destiny" and "The Last Wish".  This film immerses us in a world inhabited by kings and knights, princesses and sorcerers, priests and magicians, where fire-breathing dragons guard untold treasures, and human greed leads to an endless struggle for power, cruelty, bloodshed, and violence. And this world has its own superheroes - fearless witchers, people with magical powers. Their mission is to protect the human race from any misfortune.  The witcher Geralt of Rivia must find the young princess Ciri, kidnapped by enemies. Only her return to the small kingdom of Cintra, which was attacked by aggressors, can restore peace and order there. The brave witcher sets off on a journey, long, distant and deadly.

candidates.title: The Terrible People
candidates.overview: The ghost of a hanged man returns to fulfill his promise. All of his accusers must die!

candidates.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 Sustainable War
candidates.overview: In the year 2045, after an economic disaster known as the Synchronized Global Default, rapid developments in AI propelled the world to enter a state of "Sustainable War". However, the public is not aware of the threat that AI has towards the human race.  A compilation film with newly added footage.

candidates.title: Bounty Killer
candidates.overview: It’s been 20 years since the corporations took over the world’s governments. Their thirst for power and profits led to the Corporate Wars, a fierce global battle that laid waste to society as we know it. Born from the ash, the Council of Nine rose as a new law and order for this dark age. To avenge the corporations’ reckless destruction, the Council issues death warrants for all white collar criminals. Their hunters—the bounty killer. From amateur savage to graceful assassin, the bounty killers now compete for body count, fame and a fat stack of cash. They’re ending the plague of corporate greed and providing the survivors of the apocalypse with retribution. These are the new heroes. This is the age of the BOUNTY KILLER.

candidates.title: Stalled
candidates.overview: Late for the most important meeting of his life, a toxic executive finds himself trapped in a time paradox within a public restroom.

candidates.title: The Seventh Company Outdoors
candidates.overview: The third part of Seventh Company adventures.

candidates.title: Pepe, der Paukerschreck
candidates.overview: Mommsen Gymnasium director Taft secretly places his nephew as a spy with the difficult class of Pepe Nietnagel. During the celebration for the 100th anniversary, a simulated fire forces the school to shut down for a week. The director's attempt to get a tough teacher assigned by the department of education results in the exact opposite because of Nietnagel's intervention.

candidates.title: Mirreyes contra Godínez 2: El retiro
candidates.overview: A divided team heads to a corporate retreat after receiving an enticing proposal. During their time away, they must overcome their differences and find a way to reunite.

candidates.title: The Light Bulb Conspiracy
candidates.overview: Once upon a time... consumer goods were built to last. Then, in the 1920’s, a group of businessmen realized that the longer their product lasted, the less money they made, thus Planned Obsolescence was born, and manufacturers have been engineering products to fail ever since.  Combining investigative research and rare archive footage with analysis by those working on ways to save both the economy and the environment, this documentary charts the creation of ‘engineering to fail’, its rise to prominence and its recent fall from grace.

candidates.title: Another World
candidates.overview: An executive manager, his wife and his family, at the point when his professional choices are about to overturn all their lives. Philippe Lemesle and his wife are separating, their love irretrievably damaged by pressures of work. A successful executive in industrial conglomerate, Philippe no longer knows how to respond to the contradictory demands of his bosses. Yesterday they wanted a manager, today an enforcer. Now he must decide what his life really means.

candidates.title: Les Charlots en délire
candidates.overview: Gérard, CEO of the factory "La voix du peuple", decides to close his factory by dismissing all his staff, starting with Jean Barbier, the chief of staff, and Phil Dechambre.

candidates.title: Darkness, Light, Darkness
candidates.overview: A human body gradually reconstructs itself as its various component parts crowd themselves into a small room and eventually, after much experimentation, sort out which part goes where.

candidates.title: Fermat's Room
candidates.overview: Four mathematicians are imprisoned in a shrinking room; with the walls closing in, they must try anything to escape this fatal puzzle.

candidates.title: The Conference
candidates.overview: A ragtag group of public sector employees battle not only their own discord but also a bloodthirsty killer during a seemingly innocuous retreat.

candidates.title: Johnny Keep Walking!
candidates.overview: A simple technician at a rural factory is mistakenly promoted to a high-level managerial position at corporate headquarters due to a series of clerical errors and a bribery scheme gone wrong.
